Title: How do I rent a power bank? | Zapnivo
Description: Find a verified live station on the Find a Station map, then scan the unique QR code on the kiosk. The code opens a rental page for that specific station.

Title: Where can I return my power bank? | Zapnivo
Description: Dock it at an eligible participating Zapnivo station. Your rental confirmation and the station screen identify which locations accept returns.

Title: I paid but no power bank came out. | Zapnivo
Description: Don't pay again. Note the station and time, find the rental with Find my rental, and report it.

Title: What happens if I don't return the power bank? | Zapnivo
Description: If a power bank is not returned within 24 hours, the non-return maximum of $45 may be charged and the rental closes. This is the most a single rental can cost.

Title: What is a payment authorization (hold)? | Zapnivo
Description: A payment authorization is a temporary hold your bank may place at checkout. It is not the same as a charge.

Title: How do I request a refund? | Zapnivo
Description: Find your rental with Find my rental, then choose Request a refund, or open a ticket and select Refund request. Include your rental reference and the email used at checkout.

Title: I have a damaged or faulty power bank. | Zapnivo
Description: Stop using it and don't attempt to open or repair it. If it is safe to do so, return it to an eligible station.

Title: How do I find a past rental? | Zapnivo
Description: Use Find my rental on this page. Enter the email used at checkout plus either your rental reference (from your receipt) or the date, approximate time and station of the rental.
